verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a zero-trust networking and VPN connectivity platform, so assigning issues to a coding agent and getting back pull requests is outside its product category. The Aperture gateway and the coding-agent skill only route agents' LLM traffic or help agents edit Tailscale configuration. Nothing in the evidence shows Tailscale itself turning an issue into a pull request.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can assign an issue to an AI coding agent and receive a ready-to-review pull request
